## Mechanical inventory and preservation

The original EL-F12 retained-output manifest contains 304 H/uninjected
artifacts. The inspection selected exactly seven paths ending `_ptcdiag.nc`
and seven ending `citlali_restart_checkpoint.nc`, covering iterations 0–6.
It used `/Users/gwilson/tolteca/bin/python` and netCDF4 read-only access.
After verifying size and SHA-256 against the existing manifest, it traversed
`Dataset.variables` and any groups, recording each variable's name, dimension
names, shape and dtype. No `variable[...]` access or scientific calculation
was performed. Raw bytes were read only for hashes; no scientific array values
were decoded. Three distinct name/dimension/type schemas are deduplicated in
the receipt, with exact shapes and original file identities retained per file.
All 14 file hashes were checked again before packaging.

This inventory does not certify a frozen operator or exhaust all possible
files and reconstruction methods. No original file, spool, map, checkpoint,
archive or existing result was changed. No new scientific runtime was invoked.
